sn56.16:1.1: dhāretha no tumhe bhikkhave, “mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānī”ti.
sn56.16:1.2: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn56.16:1.3: “ahaṃ kho bhante, dhāremi bhagavatā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānī”ti.
sn56.16:2.1: “yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu, dhāresi mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānī”ti?
sn56.16:2.2: dukkhaṃ kho’haṃ bhante, “bhagavatā paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ” dhāremi.
sn56.16:2.3: yo hi koci bhante, samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā evaṃ vadeyya:
sn56.16:2.4: “netaṃ dukkhaṃ paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ samaṇena gotamena desitaṃ.
sn56.16:2.5: ahametaṃ dukkhaṃ paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paccakkhāya aññaṃ dukkhaṃ paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paññāpessāmī”ti
sn56.16:2.7: dukkhasamudayaṃ kho’haṃ bhante, bhagavatā dutiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi. yo hi koci bhante, samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā evaṃ vadeyya: “netaṃ dukkhasamudayo ariyasaccaṃ samaṇena gotamena desitaṃ, ahametaṃ dukkhasamudayaṃ dutiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paccakkhāya aññaṃ dukkhasamudayaṃ dutiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paññā passāmī”ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. dukkhanirodhaṃ kho’haṃ bhante, bhagavatā tatiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi. yo hi koci bhante, samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā evaṃ vadeyya: “netaṃ dukkhanirodho tatiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ samaṇena gotamena desitaṃ, ahametaṃ dukkhanirodhaṃ tatiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paccakkhāya aññaṃ dukkhanirodhaṃ tatiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paññāpessāmī”ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn56.16:2.8: dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ kho’haṃ bhante bhagavatā catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi.
sn56.16:2.9: yo hi koci bhante, samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā evaṃ vadeyya:
sn56.16:2.10: “netaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ samaṇena gotamena desitaṃ.
sn56.16:2.11: ahametaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paccakkhāya aññaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paññāpessāmī”ti
sn56.16:2.13: evaṃ kho’haṃ bhante, dhāremi bhagavatā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānīti.
sn56.16:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu, dhāresi. mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitāni.
sn56.16:3.3: dukkhaṃ kho bhikkhu, mayā paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ. tathā naṃ dhārehi.
sn56.16:3.4: yo hi koci bhikkhu, samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā evaṃ vadeyya:
sn56.16:3.5: “netaṃ dukkhaṃ paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ samaṇena gotamena desitaṃ.
sn56.16:3.6: ahametaṃ dukkhaṃ paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paccakkhāya aññaṃ dukkhaṃ paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paññāpessāmī”ti
sn56.16:3.10: dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā kho bhikkhu, mayā catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ. tathā naṃ dhārehi.
sn56.16:3.11: yo hi koci bhikkhu, samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā evaṃ vadeyya:
sn56.16:3.12: “netaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ samaṇena gotamena desitaṃ.
sn56.16:3.13: ahametaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paccakkhāya aññaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ paññāpessāmī”ti
sn56.16:3.15: evaṃ kho tvaṃ bhikkhu, dhārehi mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitāni.
sn56.16:4.1: tasmātiha bhikkhu, idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
